QUESTION:
What was the default value of `spool.interval_s` in PaderQueue 3.x?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0611] config | spool.interval_s (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `spool.interval_s` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `60` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | spool |
| Unit | s |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `spool.interval_s` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[spool]
interval_s = 60
```

---

[d0015] config | spool.interval_s | version 4.x
# `spool.interval_s`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `300` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | spool |
| Unit | s |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `spool.interval_s` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[spool]
interval_s = 300
```

# `spool.max_retries` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of retry attempts of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `12` |
| Available since | 3.0 |
| Component | spool |

## Notes

Changes to `spool.max_retries` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[spool]
max_retries = 12
```

response.content: The default value of `spool.interval_s` in PaderQueue 3.x was `60` seconds.
